title: Internal Control Specialist
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking an Internal Controls Specialist to oversee, design, and evaluate the internal control environment across our business units. In this role, you will lead risk assessments, execute internal audit plans, ensure regulatory compliance, and support process owners in developing robust action plans.


Requirements:

· Proven experience in Internal Controls, Internal Audit, or Risk Management within large corporations or Big Four firms (Deloitte/KPMG/EY/PwC).

· Advanced knowledge of accounting principles and GRC frameworks (COSO Internal Control & ERM, SOX/J-SOX compliance).

· Hands-on experience with process mapping, Walkthroughs, Risk & Control Matrix (RCM), and Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis.

· Advanced or Fluent English (mandatory – both spoken and written).

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields.

· Postgraduate degree in Controllership, Risk Management, Finance, or Business Management is preferred.


Key Responsibilities:

· Plan and execute end-to-end internal control testing and process reviews across key business areas (Procurement, HR, IT, Tax, Treasury, Fixed Assets, Inventory, Costs, Financial Closing, Entity-Level Controls).

· Lead the preparation of high-quality internal audit and risk assessment reports with actionable recommendations for executive management.

· Partner with Business Units (BUs) to design effective remediation action plans and coordinate systematic follow-up activities.

· Support external audit processes, acting as a primary liaison to align control evaluation results and minimize audit risks.

· Monitor departmental operational expenses and support budget tracking.

· Champion quality management, occupational safety, and environmental compliance policies within the department.

Soft Skills:

· Critical & Investigative Thinking: High analytical capacity to identify root causes, question established procedures, and audit deeply.

· Stakeholder Management & Communication: Ability to navigate and negotiate effectively across all organizational levels (from floor plant operations to C-level executives).

· Autonomy & Proactivity: Self-driven professional capable of taking ownership of projects and delivering with minimal supervision.

· Discretion & Ethical Rigor: Uncompromising commitment to integrity, compliance, and confidentiality.


Desirable Qualifications:

· Professional certifications such as CIA, CISA, CRISC, or active CRC.

· Previous experience in manufacturing/industrial environments.

· Experience conducting investigative interviews or fraud risk assessments.

· Hands-on experience with ERP systems (Oracle or SAP).

· Data analytics skills applied to auditing (Power BI, ACL, Alteryx, or SQL).

· Mandarin language skills.

  • Registrar e documentar todas as informações relevantes durante o procedimento, incluindo alterações nos parâmetros e intervenções realizadas;
  • Colaborar com aequipe médica e de enfermagem, fornecendo informações e suporte técnico durante a cirurgia;

  • Zelar pela limpeza dos equipamentos de circulação extracorpórea.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação em Enfermagem, Biomedicina, Medicina, Fisioterapia, Farmácia ou áreas afins;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Perfusão;
  • Registro profissional ativo no Conselho Regional;
  • Experiência como Perfusionista em ambiente hospitalar;
  • Conhecimento emfisiologia cardiovascular, hemodinâmica e farmacologia;
  • Experiência em procedimentos de alta complexidade, como transplantes de órgãos será um diferencial;
  • Desejável conhecimento em métodos de neuroproteção e hemofiltração;
  • Certificações adicionais, como ECLS (Extracorporeal Life Support) será um diferencial.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You’ll Do
  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack , Zoom , and Google Workspace .
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.
What We’re Looking For
  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses
Why You’ll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way
  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Sr. Functional Consultant
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Senior Functional Consultant


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us


  • Demonstrate thorough knowledge of industry best practices, business processes, o9’s solutions, technical architecture, and value proposition
  • Responsible for solution usability and uptime by resolving any customer issues in a timely fashion, ensuring the accuracy of data loads and validating the e2e workflows
  • Identify any design issues in the existing setup and coordinate with other o9 consultants to solve the business problem. Be the single point of contact for any platform level upgrade/patch/hotfix
  • Configure the o9 platform based on the change requests/enhancements post go-live and deliver them to solve deep operations / supply chain problems
  • Create and execute workflow and data analytics test cases. Work on bugs/issues and track progress at resolving issues using support tool
  • Support Super User and End User training, for a global user base
  • Actively help in improving internal processes and product features based on customer feedback by interfacing with the development and operations teams.


What you’ll have


  • Experience: 2+ years of experience with implementing supply chain demand planning applications.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems or a related field Languages: SQL, MDX, T-SQL or similar;
    Statistical, Optimization and Simulation skills through software tools and packages like R, SAS, CPLEX or similar is desirable.


Skills:

  • Deep understanding of supply chain planning concepts including Demand Management, Distribution Planning, Master Planning and S&OP.


Characteristics:

  • Strong ability to lead by example and demonstrate proficiency in both product and domain. Patient listener with the ability to clearly articulate your viewpoint to manage and deliver to customer expectations, even under pressure.
  • Ability to analyze and process large amounts of data and complement it with intuition to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks is key.
  • We really value team spirit: Transparency and frequent communication is key. At o9, this is not limited by hierarchy, distance, or function.


What We Offer


  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works


  1. Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  2. Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  3. Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  4. Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  5. Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  6. Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  7. HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.



More About Us

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Senior Business Analyst

Role Overview

The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers.

The Senior IT Business Analyst will serve as the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. This person will be responsible for understanding business needs, documenting requirements, supporting solution delivery, and helping business and technical teams maintain a shared understanding of project goals.

The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user.


Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members.
  • Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts.
  • Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements.
  • Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation.
  • Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members.
  • Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options.
  • Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management.
  • Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes.
  • Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions.
  • Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution.
  • Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs.
  • Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment.
  • Maintain regular and predictable attendance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Specifications

Education and Experience


Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst.
  • Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams.
  • Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements.
  • Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment.


Preferred

  • Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects.
  • Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives.
  • General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules.
  • Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or BusinessObjects.
  • Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.
  • Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience.


Skills and Abilities

Required

  • Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions.
  • Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes.
  • Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills.
  • Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge.
  • Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation.
  • Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work.
  • Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment.
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements.
  • Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables.


Technical Expectations

The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist.

Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

- Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

- Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

- Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

- Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

- Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

- Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.G., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

- Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

- Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

- Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

- Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

- Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

- Background in content editing or scripting

- Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Warranty Specialist
description:
Chery is a leading Chinese automotive company with a diverse portfolio that includes the R&D, production, and sales of passenger cars, commercial vehicles, mini cars, specialty vehicles, and powertrain systems. With over 8.75 million vehicles sold globally, Chery serves customers in more than 80 countries and regions worldwide.


Omoda & Jaecoo is an innovative new brand under the Chery Group, operating independently from other Chery brands. It focuses on cutting-edge design and technology in the production and sales of passenger vehicles.


About the role

The Warranty Specialist will be responsible for managing and developing warranty operations for Omoda | Jaecoo Brasil, ensuring alignment with Headquarter (HQ) standards and supporting the dealer network in all warranty-related activities. This position acts as the key interface between HQ and Brazil regarding warranty processes, policies, technical campaigns, recalls, and claim management. The professional will be responsible for implementing warranty standards across the dealer network, ensuring process compliance, improving operational efficiency, and supporting customer satisfaction objectives. The role requires strong analytical skills, organization, communication, and the ability to work closely with dealers, technical teams, HQ, and internal departments.


Key Responsibilities

Warranty Operations & Claims Management

  • Analyze and validate warranty claims submitted by the dealer network.
  • Ensure claims comply with HQ warranty policies and technical requirements.
  • Submit warranty claims and supporting documentation to HQ systems.
  • Monitor claim approval, rejection, and payment status.
  • Manage warranty payment processes to dealerships.
  • Support dealers in correcting claim submission errors and improving claim quality.
  • Monitor warranty KPIs such as claim approval rate, rejection rate, claim aging, and warranty costs.


Warranty Policies & Process Implementation

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve warranty policies and procedures for the Brazilian market.
  • Adapt HQ warranty standards and processes to local operations.
  • Ensure dealer network compliance with warranty policies, documentation standards, and operational requirements.
  • Create and maintain warranty manuals, procedures, work instructions, and operational standards.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to warranty operations.


Technical Campaigns & Recall Management

  • Coordinate implementation of technical campaigns and field actions across the dealer network.
  • Monitor campaign execution performance and completion indicators.
  • Lead recall implementation and follow-up activities when applicable.
  • Track campaign progress, vehicle completion rates, and dealer execution quality.
  • Ensure all recalls and campaigns are performed according to HQ and legal requirements.


Dealer Support & Communication

  • Act as the primary support contact for dealerships regarding warranty processes and policies.
  • Clarify warranty procedures, claim requirements, and system usage.
  • Prepare and distribute warranty bulletins, technical communications, procedures, and operational updates.
  • Support dealers in resolving warranty-related operational issues.
  • Maintain strong communication and relationship with dealer aftersales teams.


Documentation & Technical Literature Management

  • Organize and maintain warranty-related documentation and technical literature, including:
  • Warranty policies
  • Warranty manuals
  • Procedures
  • Technical bulletins
  • Campaign bulletins
  • Recall documentation
  • Dealer communications
  • Ensure all documentation is updated, standardized, and accessible to the dealer network.


Training & Network Development

  • Organize and support warranty training sessions for dealership personnel.
  • Develop training materials related to warranty processes and claim standards.
  • Promote dealer capability development and process standardization.
  • Support onboarding of new dealers regarding warranty operations.


HQ Interface & Compliance

  • Act as the operational interface between OJBR and HQ for warranty-related topics.
  • Ensure implementation of HQ warranty standards and directives.
  • Participate in meetings and alignment activities with HQ teams.
  • Provide reports, feedback, and operational insights to HQ.
  • Support audits and compliance activities related to warranty operations.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Automotive Technology, or related fields.
  • Experience in automotive aftersales and warranty operations.
  • Experience working with dealer networks and warranty systems.
  • Knowledge of automotive technical processes and claim analysis.
  • Previous experience with OEM warranty processes is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of automotive warranty processes and claim management.
  • Experience with DMS/IDMS or similar warranty systems.
  • Advanced Excel and reporting skills.
  • Ability to manage technical documentation and operational procedures.
  • Understanding of technical campaigns and recall processes.

Languages

  • English: Advanced (mandatory for communication with HQ), mandarin is a plus

Experience with KPIs

  • Warranty claim approval rate
  • Claim processing lead time
  • Warranty claim rejection reduction
  • Dealer compliance with warranty standards
  • Technical campaign completion rate
  • Recall completion performance
  • Dealer satisfaction related to warranty support
  • Warranty cost control and reporting accuracy


Additional Information

  • Frequent interaction with dealerships and HQ teams.
  • Occasional travel for dealer visits, audits, and training activities.


Location and work-model:

100% on-site (Rochaverá building - near Shopping Morumbi).

title: Import & Export Logistics Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Import & Export Logistics Analyst to support the company's import and export operations, customs clearance coordination, and logistics management. This role will work closely with freight forwarders, customs brokers, logistics providers, and internal departments to ensure the timely, compliant, and cost-effective movement of goods while supporting the company's business growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and monitor the complete import and export customs clearance process, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and company requirements.
  • Liaise with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics providers to monitor customs clearance progress and promptly resolve any issues that may arise.
  • Evaluate, select, and manage logistics service providers, coordinating ocean, air, and ground transportation to ensure the safe and timely delivery of goods.
  • Track shipment status throughout the transportation process and verify shipping, customs, and logistics documentation to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Review logistics and customs-related expenses and assist with freight cost verification and settlement.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with freight forwarders and logistics partners while continuously improving logistics processes and optimizing overall transportation and customs costs.
  • Collaborate closely with Procurement, Production, Sales, and other internal departments to ensure the smooth movement of imported materials, exported equipment, and related goods in support of business operations and growth.


Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in import/export operations, customs clearance coordination, logistics, or supply chain management.
  • Good understanding of import and export procedures, customs clearance processes, international logistics operations, and relevant regulations.
  • Familiarity with import/export documentation, including Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, and other shipping documents.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with customs brokers, freight forwarders, logistics providers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve logistics and customs-related issues efficiently.
  • Basic English communication skills for reading, writing, and handling business correspondence.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, for data management and document verification.
  • Detail-oriented, well-organized, and highly responsible.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience in logistics operations within the industrial equipment, diesel engine, generator set (genset), construction machinery, heavy equipment, or manufacturing industries is preferred.

title: Sap Architect

  • Identify and document functional gaps between standard SAP Cloud ERP processes and customer requirements;
    define resolution approaches through standard configuration, scope adjustments, or SAP BTP-based extensions, avoiding custom development.

  • Strong command of SAP Activate Methodology, with direct experience leading Fit-to-Standard workshops and producing solution documentation.

  • Strong understanding of cross-LoBintegration points (FI-MM,FI-SD, MM-PP) and their configuration dependencies within SAP Cloud ERP.

Job Title: Clinical Research Associate (CRA)

Contract: 12-Month Fixed - Brazil

Job Overview:

Kelly is pipelining talent for an evergreen CRA role in pharma. If you’re looking for a project-based career as a CRA, we’d love to have a preliminary conversation, connect with us to explore future opportunities!


This is a pipeline opportunity for proactive candidates interested in joining a global leader in the life sciences industry.

The Clinical Research Associate (CRA) is responsible for overseeing clinical trials and ensuring compliance with protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and regulatory requirements. The CRA monitors the progress of clinical studies conducted at investigative sites and ensures that data is collected, recorded, and reported accurately.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct site visits (initiation, monitoring, and closeout) to ensure adherence to study protocols and regulatory requirements.

  • Train and support site staff on study procedures and protocol requirements.
  • Ensure timely reporting of adverse events and deviations.
  • Assist in subject recruitment and retention strategies.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate monitoring reports and documentation.
  • Communicate findings and follow-up activities to stakeholders.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, or relevant field (required).
  • Prior experience as a CRA or in clinical research (3-7 years)
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and relevant regulatory guidelines.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Preferred Skills:

title: Gerente De Supply Chain Sr
description:
Será um parceiro estratégico de áreas como Comercial, Marketing, Finanças, Manufatura e stakeholders globais, liderando decisões baseadas em dados, gestão de riscos e construção de cenários para suportar o crescimento sustentável do negócio. Também é responsável por impulsionar a evolução da maturidade de Supply Chain, promovendo simplificação de processos, transformação digital, uso de analytics e inteligência artificial, melhoria contínua, desenvolvimento de pessoas e uma cultura de alta performance.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a cadeia de suprimentos end-to-end no Brasil, integrando planejamento de demanda e supply, S&OP/IBP, logística, customer service, comércio exterior e parceiros estratégicos, assegurando alinhamento com os objetivos de crescimento, rentabilidade e eficiência do negócio;
  • Conduzir e evoluir o processo de S&OP/IBP, conectando estratégia, plano financeiro, demanda, capacidade operacional e disponibilidade de produtos, com foco em decisões executivas baseadas em cenários, riscos, oportunidades e trade-offs entre serviço, custo, margem e capital de giro;
  • Fortalecer a governança de execução operacional, assegurando a conexão entre o plano de S&OP/IBP e a execução de curto prazo, com foco na antecipação de riscos, priorização de decisões operacionais e correção rápida de desvios que impactem nível de serviço, disponibilidade de produtos, estoques e performance do negócio;
  • Elevar a maturidade do planejamento por meio da melhoria contínua de forecast accuracy, forecast bias, aderência ao plano, gestão de portfólio e visibilidade de demanda, assegurando maior previsibilidade para a operação e para o negócio;
  • Definir e implementar políticas de estoque e estratégias de supply que garantam o equilíbrio entre disponibilidade de produtos, nível de serviço, capital de giro, riscos de obsolescência e eficiência operacional;
  • Liderar as operações logísticas de armazenagem, transporte e distribuição, assegurando excelência de serviço, produtividade, eficiência de custos, qualidade operacional, segurança, compliance e escalabilidade da operação;
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver a rede de parceiros logísticos, operadores, transportadoras e fornecedores estratégicos, garantindo performance, melhoria contínua, governança contratual e alinhamento aos padrões da companhia;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de distribuição e atendimento alinhadas às necessidades dos diferentes canais, clientes e regiões, contribuindo para uma experiência de cliente mais consistente, eficiente e orientada ao crescimento;
  • Liderar a agenda de Customer Service, garantindo integração com Comercial, Finanças, Logística e Planejamento, com foco em nível de serviço, ciclo do pedido, produtividade, qualidade do atendimento e excelência na jornada order-to-cash;
  • Atuar de forma próxima às áreas Comercial, Marketing, Finanças, Manufatura, Compras e stakeholders globais, influenciando decisões e assegurando alinhamento multifuncional nas prioridades de Supply Chain;
  • Gerenciar as operações de comércio exterior, assegurando fluidez no abastecimento internacional, conformidade regulatória, gestão de riscos, eficiência de custos e alinhamento com fornecedores, afiliadas e parceiros globais;
  • Liderar a transformação digital da área de Supply Chain, incorporando dados, automação, analytics e inteligência artificial como alavancas para simplificar processos, aumentar produtividade, antecipar riscos e melhorar a tomada de decisão operacional e estratégica;
  • Definir, acompanhar e comunicar indicadores-chave de performance da área, incluindo nível de serviço, OTIF, CFR, forecast accuracy, bias, aderência ao plano, inventário, capital de giro, custos logísticos, produtividade e performance de parceiros;
  • Gerir o orçamento da área e contribuir diretamente para a melhoria dos resultados financeiros, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos, otimização de working capital, produtividade e geração de valor para o negócio;
  • Promover uma cultura de melhoria contínua, disciplina de execução, colaboração multifuncional, orientação ao cliente, segurança, compliance e sustentabilidade nas operações de Supply Chain.
  • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar times multidisciplinares, fortalecendo capacidades técnicas e comportamentais, sucessão, autonomia, accountability e cultura de alta performance.

description:
Job Responsibilities:

1.Analyze customer inquiries and requirements to design technical solutions for energy storage systems, including BESS, PCS, and EMS components.

2.Evaluate technical feasibility and optimize solutions for efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

3.Prepare detailed technical documentation, including specifications, schematics, and configurations.

4.Develop and submit comprehensive bidding documents and proposals that meet regulatory, technical, and customer-specific standards.

5.Work closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, project management, and R&D, to align solutions with project goals.

6.Serve as a technical point of contact for customers during the pre-sales, proposal, and implementation phases.

7.Contribute to the development of new tools and methodologies for solution optimization.


Job Qualifications:

1.Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

2.Proficiency in creating technical documentation, schematics, and bidding documents.

3.Excellent problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.

4.Strong communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

5.Strong understanding of battery storage systems, power conversion systems, grid integration, and energy management systems is preferred.

6.Familiarity with system simulation and design tools.

7.Proficiency in English、Portuguese 、Chinese,both written and spoken, is required to effectively communicate with international teams, customers, and stakeholders.

title: Tax & Billing Analyst
description:
Join MicroPort and become part of a global healthcare company committed to advancing innovative medical technologies that improve patients' lives around the world.


As our business continues to grow in Brazil and across Latin America, we are looking for a Tax & Billing Analyst (Mid-level) to join our Finance team in São Paulo.


In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring tax compliance and supporting the complete revenue cycle, from customer master data and billing processes to revenue recognition and accounts receivable. This is an excellent opportunity for professionals who enjoy combining technical expertise, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic multinational environment.


Key Responsibilities


✔ Manage tax compliance and support statutory tax obligations.

✔ Coordinate billing activities and issue tax invoices across different sales channels.

✔ Ensure accurate revenue recognition in accordance with company policies and accounting standards.

✔ Support accounts receivable activities and collection processes.

✔ Maintain customer master data and commercial conditions in SAP.

✔ Participate in financial projects, process improvements, regulatory initiatives, and system enhancements.

✔ Support internal and external audits.


What We're Looking For


✔ Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

✔ Solid experience in Tax, Billing, or Revenue processes.

✔ Experience with SAP and advanced Excel.

✔ Intermediate English.

✔ Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, organization, and a hands-on approach.



If you are looking for your next career challenge, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Financial Controller Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America.

We originate more than R$700M per year in B2B credit to Brazilian SMEs through CrediPay, our embedded finance platform. We operate in a segment where traditional financial infrastructure is limited, building proprietary credit intelligence and risk frameworks that do not yet exist in this market.

By combining structured capital markets solutions with real-time credit decisioning, we enable marketplaces and suppliers to offer seamless payment terms to their buyers, while we manage risk, pricing, and capital efficiency behind the scenes.

We are not a traditional lender. We are building the risk engine that powers scalable B2B commerce in Brazil.


Why Join Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking FinTech primed for scale and that is tackling some of the most interesting high volume credit operations in the market.
  • Work closely with the Head of Finance and play a pivotal role in financial operations and cost control.
  • Gain exposure to high-impact financial planning, process automation, and regulatory compliance while receiving support to develop yourself as a tech-savvy controller.
  • Competitive salary, equity options , and an opportunity to make a real impact in Brazil’s digital B2B transformation.


About the Role

We’re looking for a data-minded Financial Controller that can establish accurate financial controls, optimizes costs, ensures compliance, and drives strategic financial decision-making at Credix. This position bridges operational excellence with forward-looking financial strategy. The Financial Controller will be instrumental in ensuring financial transparency, operational efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and strategic alignment, allowing Credix to make data-driven decisions on growth investments, pricing, and resource allocation.


Responsibilities

  • Implementing strong internal controls aligned with Brazilian regulatory and tax requirements (IFRS, US GAAP) .
  • Ensuring accurate financial reporting, cost tracking, budget adherence, and variance analysis .
  • Building financial models and forecasts that tie company KPIs to unit economics and growth initiatives.
  • Leading FP&A analytics to answer critical questions: What drives profitability? Where should we invest? What's our path to profitability?
  • Optimizing cost structures and driving profitability.


Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience in Financial Controlling, FP&A, Cost Control, or similar finance roles.
  • Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and variance analysis.
  • Analytical mindset with experience in cost management, expense tracking, and profitability analysis.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian tax regulations, IFRS, GAAP, and financial compliance requirements.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial modeling and scenario analysis.
  • Tech-savvy with experience using SQL, Python, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI), or financial automation tools.
  • Experience with ERP systems and accounting software.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate financial insights into business recommendations.
  • Process-driven, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Previous experience in fintech, credit, lending, or financial services is a strong advantage.


What We Offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.


But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.


Ready to Join Us?

If you’re passionate about financial control, cost optimization, and scaling a fast-growing FinTech, apply now and help shape the future of B2B credit in Brazil! 🚀

title: Sales Manager
description:
Who We Are

Sunwave is a global wireless infrastructure company with a comprehensive portfolio spanning DAS, Small Cells, Open RAN, Private Networks, Network CPE, and SATCOM. Backed by 30+ years of engineering heritage, we are a publicly listed company on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), providing strong financial stability and long-term commitment to our customers and partners. Our International Headquarters (IHQ) in Singapore is scaling rapidly, with business coverage across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.



The Role

We are looking for a LATAM Wireless Sales Manager to drive sales growth and market expansion for wireless products across Latin America. You will formulate targeted sales strategies, manage key customer and partner relationships, and deliver annual sales targets by capturing opportunities in the LATAM wireless communications market.


What you'll do:

  • Develop sales strategies and objectives by analyzing market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape of wireless products in LATAM
  • Deeply engage with mainstream operators and key clients to achieve annual sales targets within budget
  • Track, document and report all sales activities and annual OTE objectives to line manager
  • Own designated countries/clients to secure potential project orders and drive business closure
  • Maintain key customer relationships, capture sales opportunities and expand sales channels in LATAM
  • Lead partner recruitment and product ecosystem development in LATAM markets
  • Collect and analyze LATAM wireless communications market data, monitor competitors, and provide market insights and decision support


What we need:

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Communications Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications or related field
  • Ability to understand technical parameters and solutions of wireless coverage products, and conduct product demonstrations and client presentations
  • Over 5 years of sales experience in wireless communications industry (4G/5G, DAS, private networks, RAN, Small Cells)
  • Proven experience in building and maintaining sales lead relationships
  • Track record in developing channel ecosystems (SI, VAR, MSP) and driving partner-led sales growth
  • Strong knowledge of direct sales (telecom operators/key clients) and channel sales models
  • Experience in new client development and familiarity with procurement processes and decision chains of telecom operators and enterprise clients
  • Strong sense of responsibility, ability to work under pressure, adapt to multicultural environments and teamwork
  • Willingness to travel internationally frequently

title: Senior Aml Investigations & Case Specialist
description:
This role supports the MLRO in fulfilling the company's AML/CFT obligations by conducting local transaction monitoring investigations, screening reviews, case analysis, and suspicious activity assessments. The role is responsible for ensuring that investigative analysis, case documentation, and reporting recommendations are performed and maintained within Brazil in accordance with local regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct investigations into transaction monitoring alerts, sanctions screening hits, and other financial crime cases relating to the Brazilian entity.
  • Analyse customer activity and transaction patterns to identify suspicious activity and document investigative findings.
  • Prepare and maintain complete investigation case files and supporting documentation.
  • Support the MLRO in assessing and recommending suspicious transaction reports to Coaf.
  • Perform local sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening reviews where required.
  • Escalate complex investigations, emerging risks, and material findings to the MLRO.
  • Maintain accurate records of investigations and case decisions for regulatory and audit purposes.
  • Work with global AML teams to obtain supporting intelligence while retaining ownership of the local investigative assessment.
  • Support regulatory examinations, audits, and ongoing enhancement of AML controls and monitoring processes.

Requirements

  • Brazilian citizen with the legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Must be based in Brazil
  • 3–5 years of experience in AML, transaction monitoring, financial crime investigations, or compliance within a regulated financial institution, fintech, payment institution, or cryptocurrency exchange.
  • Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, suspicious transaction reporting, and financial crime typologies.
  • Experience with transaction monitoring systems, sanctions screening, and case management tools.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.
  • Embraces AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline compliance processes, and enhance the quality of regulatory analysis and decision-making.

Profile

  • Strong analytical and investigative judgement with excellent attention to detail.
  • Able to make sound, risk-based decisions independently while maintaining high standards of documentation.
  • Collaborative, hands-on, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
  • Passionate about cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and the evolving digital asset ecosystem, with a genuine curiosity to stay ahead of industry and regulatory developments.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.G., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Professor De Espanhol
description:

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.

  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.


Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.


Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions;
    final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.



Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets;
    familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.


Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Customer Development Executive - Fortaleza
description:
Role Summary

The Indirect Channel Sales Executive will be primarily responsible for the strategic and commercial management of Distributor and Wholesale accounts in the state of Ceará. The professional will act as a business enabler, ensuring excellence in the execution of commercial processes, rigorous management of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and the rollout of the company’s retail strategy through channel partners.

The primary objective of the role is to ensure operational efficiency, sustainable sell-out growth, and the strict application of the 5Ps strategy (Product, Price, Place, Promotion, and Point of Display/Placement), as well as training and engaging the distributor’s sales force.

Responsibilities

  • Account Management: Develop and maintain strategic commercial relationships with customers (Distribution and Wholesale), leading volume, margin, and promotional calendar negotiations.
  • Sales Planning: Manage sell-in targets (sales to the distributor) and, as a priority, accelerate sell-out (sales from the distributor to retail), ensuring healthy inventory levels.
  • Execution at Point of Sale (POS): Ensure the implementation of the 5Ps pillars in the market served by the distributor, monitoring optimal assortment, correct pricing, and brand visibility.
  • KPI Analysis: Monitor and analyze reports on distribution/activation, market coverage, out-of-stocks, days of inventory, and profitability, designing action plans to correct deviations.
  • Sales Force Management and Training: Train, upskill, and motivate the distributor’s sales and supervisory teams, carrying out field routines (coaching loop) to ensure alignment with Colgate standards.
  • Budget Management: Manage the commercial investment budget (sell-out funds, rebates, and trade marketing activities) efficiently.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience in the commercial area.
  • Driver’s license
  • 50% travel

Preferred Qualifications

Intermediate English.

Modelo de trabalho

description:

majors in Logistics Management, Supply Chain, or related fields are preferred. Experience: 1+ years of experience in logistics or operational support. Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to meticulousness and process compliance. Language Requirements: Bilingual in Chinese and Portuguese.

.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como?

  • Comercialização das áreas vagas: prospecção de novos lojistas, análise SWOT dos espaços ofertados(pontos fortes x desafios), negociações de valores e condições contratuais com lojistas, acompanhamento após a assinatura do contrato;
  • Estabelecer contato inicial com lojista: prospecção do contato comercial referente à marca indicada pelo Mix, apresentação da oportunidade para o lojista e captura de interesse preliminar do mesmo, agendamento e realização de reuniões;
  • Negociação: Elaboração da proposta comercial (Salesforce) com base nas metas definidas pelo Iguatemi, apresentação da proposta para o lojista e negociação da mesma, ajustes na proposta comercial se necessário, atualização do status de cada negociação no sistema, envio de informações técnicas sobre o SUC e levantamento junto ao lojista de eventuais necessidades de alterações para serem aprovadas e discutidas com demais áreas;
  • Acompanhar o andamento da proposta comercial no fluxo de aprovações e, após alçadas de aprovações internas, efetuar o retorno para o lojista;
  • Fechamento: Coleta de documentação e assinatura de contrato do lojista, entrega dos documentos para equipe de operações comerciais responsável pelos inputs de dados cadastrais;
  • Acompanhamento: Uma vez assinado o contrato, apresentar o lojista à equipe de operações e manutenção, efetuar o acompanhamento da obra periodicamente de modo a garantir abertura da loja. Uma vez que a loja esteja aberta, realizar as boas vindas ao lojista e passagem de bastão para área de operações;
  • Alimentar a base de contatos de lojistas do Iguatemi (Salesforce), fazendo inputs de dados cadastrais do mesmo (completando o que é previamente enviado por mix);

title: Representante Comercial Autônomo (Pj) Freight Forwarder / Nvocc
description:
Sobre a Seafrigo


Somos a Seafrigo, empresa francesa de logística global com mais de 40 anos de experiência, especializada em logística com temperatura controlada e focada na indústria alimentícia.

Com sede global em Le Havre, França, atuamos nos cinco continentes por meio de 26 escritórios, com forte presença nos principais mercados mundiais de carga perecível, entregando soluções sob medida e confiáveis aos nossos clientes.


Sobre a oportunidade


A Seafrigo Brasil está selecionando representante comercial autônomo (pessoa jurídica) , nos termos da Lei nº 4.886/65, para intermediação de negócios.


Trata-se de contratação de prestação de serviços de representação comercial, sem vínculo empregatício, com plena autonomia do representante quanto à organização de sua agenda e roteiro de visitas.


Escopo dos serviços


  • Prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de carteira de clientes no segmento de carga refrigerada (reefer), com foco em relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Identificação de oportunidades de negócio e mapeamento de prospects segmentados no mercado de perecíveis.
  • Apresentação de propostas comerciais e condução de negociações, observadas as condições comerciais e tabelas de preço definidas pela representada.
  • Intermediação e encaminhamento de pedidos.
  • Representação da marca Seafrigo em feiras e eventos do setor.
  • Compartilhamento periódico de informações sobre negócios intermediados e pipeline, na forma e periodicidade acordadas em contrato.


Perfil desejado


  • Experiência comprovada em intermediação comercial de campo, preferencialmente junto a freight forwarders ou NVOCCs.
  • Sólido conhecimento do mercado de carga perecível, especialmente frutas e proteínas.
  • Carteira de clientes própria e ativa.
  • Excelentes habilidades de negociação, comunicação e construção de relacionamento.
  • Perfil consultivo, estratégico e orientado a resultados.
  • Inglês avançado, para atuação em ambiente internacional.
  • Conhecimento do mercado de carga perecível, especialmente frutas e proteínas (grande vantagem).
  • Conhecimento de carga seca é um diferencial — há espaço para desenvolvimento de negócios também nesse segmento.
  • Desejável formação superior em Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais, Administração ou áreas correlatas.


Requisitos formais


  • Pessoa jurídica ativa, com CNAE compatível com a atividade de representação comercial.
  • Registro no CORE-SP (ou condições de obtê-lo antes do início da prestação).
  • Capacidade de emissão de nota fiscal de serviços e regularidade fiscal.
  • CNH categoria B e meios próprios de deslocamento para visitas a clientes.


Modelo de contratação


  • Contrato de representação comercial regido pela Lei nº 4.886/65.
  • Retribuição composta por parcela fixa e comissionamento sobre negócios concretizados, mediante apresentação de nota fiscal.
  • Sem cláusula de exclusividade — vedada apenas a representação simultânea de concorrentes diretos.
  • Zona de atuação: Território nacional, foco principal no Estado de São Paulo e região Sudeste.

title: Product Designer
description:
Sobre a ALTAVE

Vaga PJ - Híbrida, com atuação presencial uma vez por semana em São José dos Campos


Proteger vidas e recursos com tecnologia é o propósito que nos guia.

Fundada por engenheiros do ITA, a ALTAVE atua há mais de 15 anos no desenvolvimento de soluções de videomonitoramento com inteligência artificial para redução de riscos, prevenção de acidentes e aumento da eficiência operacional.

Atendemos empresas dos setores de óleo e gás, mineração, energia, indústria e infraestrutura, com atuação no Brasil e em mercados internacionais.


Sobre os valores

Trabalhamos em um ambiente colaborativo, direto e orientado a resultados, onde autonomia vem acompanhada de responsabilidade.

  • O desafio nos inspira
  • Integridade e honestidade nas relações
  • Confiança mútua como base do trabalho
  • Autonomia com responsabilidade e excelência
  • Somos espirituosos
  • Sua missão


Na ALTAVE, o(a) Product Designer será responsável por transformar tecnologias complexas e grandes volumes de dados em experiências digitais claras, consistentes e eficientes.

Sua missão será compreender os desafios dos usuários e do negócio, projetando interfaces que facilitem a interpretação de informações e apoiem a tomada de decisão em operações críticas.

Você atuará em colaboração com Produto, Customer Success e Engenharia, conectando necessidades reais dos usuários à evolução dos produtos digitais da ALTAVE.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar jornadas, fluxos, interfaces e protótipos de média e alta fidelidade.
  • Evoluir a experiência dos usuários com base em requisitos de negócio, pesquisas, feedbacks e dados.
  • Colaborar com Product Managers, Customer Success, Engenharia e demais stakeholders na definição e validação de soluções.
  • Utilizar e evoluir o Design System da ALTAVE no Figma, garantindo consistência e escalabilidade.
  • Participar de pesquisas, entrevistas, discoveries, testes de usabilidade e análises de mercado.
  • Planejar e conduzir validações de conceitos, fluxos e protótipos com usuários e áreas internas.
  • Validar a implementação das interfaces junto ao time de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade visual e funcional.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de UX, UI, acessibilidade, arquitetura da informação e design responsivo.
  • Documentar fluxos, decisões de design, componentes e padrões utilizados nos produtos.
  • Realizar o handoff para desenvolvimento com especificações claras e completas.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Design e desenvolvimento de produto.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de três anos como Product Designer, UX Designer, UI Designer ou em funções relacionadas.
  • Domínio do Figma para criação de fluxos, interfaces, componentes e protótipos interativos.
  • Experiência na aplicação e evolução de Design Systems.
  • Conhecimento de UX, UI, usabilidade, acessibilidade, arquitetura da informação e design responsivo.
  • Experiência com pesquisa, definição de jornadas e validação de soluções com usuários.
  • Capacidade de transformar requisitos técnicos e de negócio em experiências claras e funcionais.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Inglês para participação em discoveries, reuniões e interações com clientes internacionais.
  • Organização, pensamento analítico, atenção aos detalhes e autonomia na condução das demandas.
  • Portfólio que demonstre processo de Design, decisões tomadas e resultados dos projetos.

Diferenciais que valorizamos

  • Experiência com produtos SaaS, B2B ou plataformas industriais.
  • Vivência com produtos que apresentam grande volume de dados, dashboards ou sistemas de monitoramento.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de produto e análise do comportamento dos usuários.
  • Familiaridade com Scrum, Kanban ou outras metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em GA4, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Glassbox ou ferramentas similares.
  • Experiência com documentação funcional e handoff para desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento básico de tecnologias front-end e limitações técnicas de implementação.
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, inteligência artificial, IoT ou videomonitoramento.


Aqui você encontra

Um ambiente tecnológico e desafiador, com espaço para propor soluções, participar de decisões de produto e trabalhar diretamente com equipes técnicas e usuários.

Você terá contato com produtos que integram inteligência artificial, videomonitoramento e análise de dados, contribuindo para tornar informações complexas mais claras e aplicáveis à rotina dos clientes.

Somos GPTW e estamos no Ranking 2025 das Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar na Indústria.


Adicionais

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, Flash, TotalPass, Clude, day off no aniversário, entre outros benefícios.


E aí, ficou interessado(a)?

Se esse desafio faz sentido para você e para o momento da sua carreira, queremos te conhecer!
